speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have presented with a breast mass; to begin my assessment, how long have you been aware of this lump, and has its size or texture changed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given the rapid growth of this left breast mass over just four weeks, have you noticed any associated skin changes, such as dimpling, redness, or warmth? Also, please tell me if you are experiencing any pain or if you feel any new lumps in the armpit area.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since you report no pain, skin changes, or lymph node involvement, and the mass is growing rapidly over four weeks, I need to assess your hormonal status. REQUEST TEST: Serum estrogen and progesterone levels. Also, please confirm if you are currently pregnant or breastfeeding. DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Breast Carcinoma (unlikely given no skin changes) or Phyllodes Tumor; pending imaging results, consider Rapidly growing Fibroadenoma or malignancy. REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram and Breast Ultrasound.
